note: Go-bag challenge (src/scenes/GoBag.js). One set per disaster: 12 items, the `correct` ones are the essentials to pack. `item` is a props.png frame (tools/make-scenes.py PROPS). `why` is shown after the round. PLACEHOLDER until the research team checks it against their sources.

flood.title: FLOOD GO-BAG
flood.situation: PAGASA raised a heavy rainfall warning. The barangay may ask families to evacuate tonight.

items.name: Drinking water
items.why: Floodwater is dirty. Bring clean water to drink.

items.name: Flashlight
items.why: Power often goes out during floods.

items.name: Battery radio
items.why: Listen to warnings even without power or signal.

items.name: First aid kit
items.why: Treat small cuts right away so they don't get infected.

items.name: Documents in plastic
items.why: IDs and papers are needed for relief and must stay dry.

items.name: Medicine
items.why: Bring the family's daily medicine for at least 3 days.

items.name: Game console
items.why: Heavy and not needed to survive.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Not useful in an evacuation.

items.name: Perfume
items.why: Not an essential. Save space.

items.name: Big stuffed toy
items.why: Takes space that essentials need.

items.name: School books
items.why: Heavy, and they get wet. Keep only documents.

items.name: Candles
items.why: Fire risk in a crowded evacuation center. Use a flashlight.

fire.title: FIRE GO-BAG
fire.situation: Fires happen often in crowded markets and houses. Keep a small bag ready by the door.

items.name: Flashlight
items.why: Smoke makes it dark. Light helps you find the exit.

items.name: Face mask
items.why: Helps a little against smoke and dust after the fire.

items.name: Whistle
items.why: Call for help without breathing in smoke by shouting.

items.name: First aid kit
items.why: For small burns and cuts.

items.name: Documents in plastic
items.why: Papers burn. Keep copies in the go-bag.

items.name: Drinking water
items.why: Smoke dries your throat. Bring water.

items.name: Perfume
items.why: Flammable. Never near a fire.

items.name: Candles
items.why: An open flame can start another fire.

items.name: Game console
items.why: Leave things behind. Your life comes first.

items.name: School books
items.why: Heavy and not needed.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Not useful in an emergency.

items.name: Big stuffed toy
items.why: Takes space that essentials need.

earthquake.title: EARTHQUAKE GO-BAG
earthquake.situation: Earthquakes come without warning. Your bag must be ready before the shaking starts.

items.name: Whistle
items.why: If you are trapped, a whistle is heard farther than a voice.

items.name: Flashlight
items.why: Power may be cut after a strong quake.

items.name: Drinking water
items.why: Water lines can break. Bring water for 3 days.

items.name: Canned food
items.why: Food that keeps without cooking or a fridge.

items.name: First aid kit
items.why: For cuts from broken glass and falling things.

items.name: Hard hat
items.why: Protects your head from falling debris and aftershocks.

items.name: Game console
items.why: Not needed to survive.

items.name: Glass perfume
items.why: Glass can break and cut you.

items.name: Candles
items.why: Gas may leak after a quake. No open flames.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Not useful in an emergency.

items.name: Big stuffed toy
items.why: Takes space that essentials need.

items.name: School books
items.why: Heavy. Keep the bag light so you can move fast.

eruption.title: ASHFALL GO-BAG
eruption.situation: Taal is erupting and ash is falling on Santa Cruz. Pack what protects you from the ash.

items.name: N95 face mask
items.why: Ash hurts your lungs. A good mask filters it.

items.name: Goggles
items.why: Ash scratches your eyes. Goggles keep it out.

items.name: Drinking water
items.why: Ash can dirty the water supply.

items.name: Battery radio
items.why: Listen for PHIVOLCS updates and evacuation orders.

items.name: Damp cloth or towel
items.why: Cover your nose and mouth if you have no mask.

items.name: Medicine
items.why: Ash can make asthma worse. Bring inhalers and medicine.

items.name: Game console
items.why: Not needed to survive.

items.name: Perfume
items.why: Not an essential. Save space.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Not useful in an emergency.

items.name: Big stuffed toy
items.why: Takes space that essentials need.

items.name: School books
items.why: Heavy and not needed.

items.name: Candles
items.why: A flashlight is safer.
